question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

EVIDENT
solution:
The correct answer is **'Clear'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's see the meanings of the given words-
 
 
• **Evident- **easily seen or understood आसानी से देखा या समझा गया
 
• **Clear- **easy to understand, hear, read, or see समझने, सुनने, पढ़ने या देखने में आसान
 
• **Aimless- **without any clear intentions, purpose, or direction बिना किसी स्पष्ट इरादे, उद्देश्य या दिशा के
 
• **Complex- **involving a lot of different but related parts बहुत से अलग लेकिन संबंधित भागों को शामिल करना
 
• **Confusing- **Something that is confusing makes you feel confused because it is difficult to understand कुछ ऐसा जो भ्रमित करने वाला हो, आपको भ्रमित करता है क्योंकि इसे समझना मुश्किल है
 
 
 
• Hence, according to the meanings of the given words, the correct synonym is **Clear i.e. Option 1.**
